rapport_notes: Warm, conversational opener; friendly acknowledgment throughout; natural pacing and tone.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not follow silence after open-ended questions (e.g., after asking about boxes, immediately pivots without pause for customer elaboration); minor repeat of damage coverage messaging (mentioned twice in slightly different forms: 'pat and wrap all furniture items to prevent damages they're all fully insured' and later 'no worries damage coverage...allocate up to $2,000').

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Would you, would you be available to do maybe like some sort of quick virtual walkthrough. It takes about twenty minutes or so we could just kind of see the furniture that we're going to be moving and then from there, I can get you the most accurate estimate.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly to logistics (move date, square footage, inventory) without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We're going to pat and wrap all those furniture items to prevent damages they're all fully insured...we include our no worries damage coverage. It's just higher evaluation for your items we allocate up to $2,000 per move.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: All of our movers are also background checked and trained by us. They're not day labors, they're all on our website with their pictures and BIOS.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We also have an on time guarantee. So if we're ever late to like an arrival window, we give you we do discount you.
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered. No mention of day-before call, crew lead name, or inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Moving locally it's roughly the equivalent about maybe a one bedroom kind of move which usually is about a three to four hour ish type of deal. So with the drive included, I'd probably put you in the range of about six to seven hours...you're probably gonna be looking in the range of about $1,900 to if it took seven hours $2,114.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: We bill in fifteen minute increments so you just pay for the time that's actually used.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: As long as there's not a, a bunch of extra miscellaneous that should be a, a very on pretty on point estimate.
evidence_quotes.close: What I'll do on is, I'll email you this quote it'll outline the pricing the fee...if you end up wanting to get on the calendar for that date you can just email us back and let us know to, to book it. [No rate-lock language; no explicit 'would you like our help' ask.]

top_strength: Clean and professional routing to a virtual walkthrough for a large-move scenario (2000→1450 sq ft downsizing); correctly identified the need for a visual and locked in a 20-minute walkthrough commitment rather than attempting a full phone quote.
coaching_note: Missing the agenda question entirely — rep should ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' before diving into inventory logistics; also missing Communication differentiator (day-before call, crew lead name, inbox updates) which should have been delivered in the pricing/takeaway section given the customer never raised it.
